_comment: Edit `default` to publish under a real named person — that is worth considerably more for E-E-A-T than a team byline. Set type to 'Person', put the real name in `name`, and fill `jobTitle`, `bio` and `credentials` with things that are actually true. Add `sameAs` links (LinkedIn, X, personal site) so Google can corroborate the identity. Do not invent a person or credentials: fabricated authorship is a spam signal and misleads readers.

singh-yogendra.name: Singh Yogendra
singh-yogendra.jobTitle: Founder and salary research lead at SalaryPedia
singh-yogendra.bio: Singh Yogendra is the founder of SalaryPedia, a salary research site covering 195 countries and 31 career categories. He compiles compensation data from published research, normalises it into a consistent structure, and writes the guides that explain it. Every article is reviewed against source data before publication.
credentials: Salary data compiled from the Economic Research Institute (ERI) and SalaryExpert
Coverage of 195 countries and 31 career categories

reviewPolicy: Articles are written by Singh Yogendra and checked against the salary data published on this site. Figures are estimates drawn from third-party compensation research, not offers or guarantees.
